hypotheses.generalization: Development cascade has 136/723 raw-family errors and 129/723 family-policy rejections. Slower joint fitting with four times UNKNOWN training draws may improve separation; paired arm adds small train-only spectral masks.

training.initialization: same installed attention checkpoint for every arm
training.feature_or_audio_augmentation: v2_masked only: one 0..4 mel-band mask and one 0..min(12,frames/10) frame mask per recording; other arm none
training.audio_frontend: unchanged installed 40-bin log-mel and frozen normalization

splits: Preserve original speaker-disjoint train/dev(policy_fit,selection)/calibration/test. Original calibration is excluded from fitting. Test is untouched and already historical regression, not fresh blind evidence. Synthetic train voices only supplement fitting; human dev alone selects models/policies.

primary_test.population: Original 4314 human test recordings including 1783 finite references
primary_test.thresholds: Existing >=20 accepts and >=95% value/command precision; color >=99%, family shared <=1% UNKNOWN allowance; fitted on policy_fit dev only.

selection: Rank development candidates by satisfying command precision and UNKNOWN gates, then exact finite-command recall, then minimum supported-family recall. Checkpoints selected on development only. Lock graph/policy/data hashes before any test inference.

separate_reports.deterministic: Raw family and finite-head exact classification before gates, accepted complete commands after gates, per family, rejection and failure cascade.
separate_reports.custom: Use E13 custom-protocol-v3, with reserved enrollment speakers and selection/test queries.
separate_reports.numbers: Raw amount classification separately from complete numeric commands. All 0..100 in a seeded random order on held-out synthetic voices; original human numeric commands remain separate. Bare numbers/distractors are separate stress cases if acquired, never substituted for human command results.

synthetic_scope: Existing labeled Qwen whole-utterance recordings reused without modifying their manifest or voices. Any additional synthesis requires a separately frozen stress-data plan, original full utterances, and provenance. No word splicing.
protected: All E13 receipts/checkpoints, original data and installed E12 artifacts. No test inference has occurred in E13/E14.
ignore_gate: Existing committed scoped rules passed; no ignore edits/commits necessary.
data: Reuse immutable E13 manifest and feature cache, no new source data. This is a separately declared augmented follow-up, not the historical human-only parameter studies.
